reason: The first passive native AFS fit converged, but it supplied only two original actual-sample gaps in 10-65 GHz and its dense grid had a 1.145833334 GHz maximum step below 100 GHz. Preserve that run as unqualified frequency evidence. Add forced 20/40 GHz samples to strengthen independent-gap selection and native output-grid coverage; retain the original electrical and comparison limits.

native_afs.response: S_50 as generated by ADS; this is not a frequency or output-point count
native_afs.actual_source: raw_MomMW.ds and proj.sio; export complete raw-discrete.s2p
native_afs.derived_source: ADS-generated raw_MomMW_a.ds; export complete dense-afs.s2p explicitly labeled rational-model output
native_afs.dense_grid: Inspect the actual returned grid. Require at most 1 GHz spacing through 100 GHz and at most 5 GHz through 200 GHz, including the 10/65/80/100/200 boundaries from exact data where needed. Preserve original frequency arrays.
native_afs.prohibited: Do not call rational-model values raw EM solves or silently replace actual data. No extrapolation or passivity repair.

independent_frequency_validation.additional_rule: Select at least seven midpoints of the largest unsampled actual-AFS intervals, including at least three in 10-65 GHz. Selection depends only on sampling gaps, not on target margins.
independent_frequency_validation.treatment: Add interpolation uncertainty to measured mesh and port uncertainty. Unresolved convergence, coverage or passivity gives INDETERMINATE.

low_frequency.DC: Independent finite-conductivity sheet solve with terminal-contact declaration; compare against low-frequency RF before adding any DC extension.

fallback: If native AFS output or independent checks fail, use the original explicit-frequency protocol. No electrical target or numerical convergence limit is relaxed.
